explanation: Nothing obliged Guterres to resign: he had a legislature running to 2003 and the local result changed no seat in the Assembly. He resigned on the night, in his own phrase to avoid the country falling into a political swamp, and the president dissolved the Assembly in December for an election in March. The election of 2002 exists because of a ballot that was not about it, and the atlas keeps the edge as `caused` because the chain has no other link in it: local defeat, resignation, dissolution, early election, all inside three months.
